newsitem.title: USA: Jean-Claude Van Damme enters substance abuse clinic.
newsitem.headline: Jean-Claude Van Damme enters substance abuse clinic.

text.p: Action movie star Jean-Claude Van Damme has entered a substance abuse clinic in southern California, his publicist said on Thursday.

Van Damme "entered himself" in the clinic at Daniel Freeman Marina Hospital in Marina del Rey last Saturday where he is taking part in a 30-day treatment programme, his public relations firm said in a short statement.
It did not say what substance he was being treated for.
Martial arts fan Van Damme has starred in such films as "Universal Soldier" and "Timecop". His last film "Maximum Risk" opened at the top of the U.S. box office in September.

Van Damme has had a troubled relationship with his fourth wife, Darcy. She filed for divorce in November 1994, less than a year after the couple wed. They got back together and their son Nicolas was born in September last year. Darcy Van Damme filed for divorce for a second time in June, citing irreconcilable differences, but they are reported to have reunited again.
